[roadway], near the sidewalk and near the building's driveway. p's right eyebrow was cut open, and medic [medical facility] for stitches. p was very uncooperative [medical facility]. p stated he was fine to leave the crash scene [medical facility] by medic 15, and eventually [medical facility] via medic 15. sgt s. johnson #3145 was notified of the situation. there were no witnesses on scene. i called back the number of the person who called the crash in, and the caller stated he believed he saw a pickup truck crash into p, and he called police. the caller did not stay at the scene and did not want to be contacted. we could not determine exactly where the crash happened, and exactly how the crash happened due to a lack of evidence and the victim's inability to properly communicate what happened.
